y-m-40-03.s.s3.hint.1: Duba abin da ke faruwa idan biyu sun shiga gurbi ɗaya, sannan ƙirga hanyoyin sanya su a gurabe daban-daban.

y-m-40-03.s.s3.r.b: Wannan tunani ne da ya fara jera D, E, F, sannan ya ninka da hanyoyin sanya A, B, C bi da bi a gurabe daban-daban da suka samu.
y-m-40-03.s.s3.r.c: Wannan ya ɗauka A, B, C kowannensu zai zaɓi kowane daga wurare 4. Ya rasa cewa idan biyu sun shiga gurbi ɗaya, za su zama maƙwabta.
y-m-40-03.s.s3.r.d: Wannan ƙima ce da ta yi amfani da yawan hanyoyin jera mutane 6 kawai, ba tare da amfani da sharadin rashin zama maƙwabta ba.
y-m-40-03.s.s3.explain: Yawan hanyoyin jera D, E, F da farko shi ne 3!=6, sannan akwai gurabe 4: 2 a ƙarshen da 2 a tsakiya. Yawan hanyoyin zaɓar gurabe daban-daban uku da sanya A, B, C bi da bi shi ne 4×3×2=24. Ninkawa yana ba da 6×24=144. Hanyar cirewa daga jimilla tana da wahala domin akwai ma’aurata maƙwabta uku kuma sai an kula da yanayin da suka haɗu.

y-m-40-08.goal: Bayan nemo yawan gajerun hanyoyi, tantance yadda suke canzawa mataki-mataki idan aka toshe sashe, kuma ka fahimci idan sassa biyu aka toshe, hanyoyin da suka haɗu dole a cire su sau ɗaya kawai.
y-m-40-08.material: Hanyoyin gari suna kama da allon dara. A grid mai faɗin raka’a 4 da tsayin raka’a 3, kana tafiya daga gida (kusurwar ƙasa ta hagu) zuwa makaranta (kusurwar sama ta dama), ta dama (→) ko sama (↑) raka’a ɗaya a kowane mataki. Idan aka rubuta mahadar a matsayin (matsayi a kwance, matsayi a tsaye), gida (0, 0) ne, makaranta (4, 3). Za a bayyana bayanai mataki-mataki.

y-m-40-09.topic: Haɗuwa: adadin rectangles a cikin grid da gwada gaba ɗaya
y-m-40-09.goal: Gwada tare da misalan misalan ko dabarar da ta yi daidai a misali ɗaya ta riƙe gabaɗaya, nemo grid kai tsaye inda hanyoyin biyu suka dace, kuma faɗi dalilin.
y-m-40-09.material: Akwai grid inda p a kwance layukan da q na tsaye suka hadu a kusurwoyi dama. Misali, idan p=3 da q=3, grid ne na kananan murabba'i 2×2 kamar allon dubawa. Yi tunani game da adadin rectangles (ciki har da murabba'ai) a cikin wannan grid wanda gefensa ke kwance akan layi. Teo ya ce, "Na kirga rectangles a cikin grid mai layi mai layi 3 da layi na tsaye 3 kuma na samu 9. Don haka adadin rectangles shine (yawan layin kwance) × (yawan layi na tsaye)."

y-m-40-09.s.s1.explain: Domin kawai dabara da kimar sun kasance iri ɗaya a misali ɗaya ba yana nufin yana riƙe da gaba ɗaya ba. 3 × 3 da Teo ya zaɓa shine ainihin lamarin da ba kasafai ba inda dabi'u biyu suka yarda (zamu duba a mataki na gaba). Ya kamata a fara gwajin ba da babban grid ba amma tare da ƙaramin ƙarami kamar layin kwance 2 da layukan tsaye 2, wanda kuma yana da sauƙin ƙirga kai tsaye.
y-m-40-09.s.s2.prompt: Bayan 3 × 3, akwai wasu grid inda furucin Teo p × q ya faru daidai da ainihin adadin rectangles. Lokacin da p da q suke lamba aƙalla 2, nemo irin wannan grid banda 3×3 kuma shigar da shi. Ainihin adadin rectangles shine (yawan hanyoyin da za a zaɓi 2 na layin kwance) × (yawan hanyoyin zaɓi 2 na layin tsaye).
y-m-40-09.s.s2.hint.0: Fara daga p=2, q=2, ƙara su ɗaya bayan ɗaya kuma tsara p×q da ainihin adadin rectangles a cikin tebur.
y-m-40-09.s.s2.hint.1: Lokacin da dabi'u biyu suka daidaita, sauƙaƙa sashin gama gari ga ɓangarorin biyu kuma duba menene alaƙar p da q ta rage.

y-m-40-09.s.s2.fail.c1: Da fatan za a yi p da q lamba masu 2 ko mafi girma.

y-m-40-09.s.s2.explain: Rarraba ɓangarorin biyu na p ×q = [p (p-1)/2] × [q (q-1)/2] ta p ×q yana ba da (p-1) (q-1) = 4. Tun da (p-1, q-1) = (2, 2), (1, 4), (4, 1), (p, q) = (3, 3), (2, 5), (5, 2) su ne kawai. Don haka wanda kawai za ku iya samu banda 3 × 3 shine 2 × 5 (ko 5 × 2). Misali, don (2, 5), p×q=10 kuma ainihin adadin rectangles shine C(2,2)×C(5,2)=1×10=10, wanda yayi daidai. Grids inda suke daidai suke wannan ba kasafai bane, don haka 3 × 3 da Teo ya fara ɗauka kawai ya zama shari'ar da ke aiki.
